verdict.rationale: Instinct is an autonomous agent, so headless or CI-driven automation is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence shows no headless mode, CLI, API or CI integration. Its documented interfaces are texting or calling it and its Mac and mobile apps, and the vendor's sitemap declares no developer surface at all.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
